prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. Inside the ark, a family of eight in silhouette sits close together on the plank floor in the grey daylight falling through a long gap under the roof beams, animals resting in straw stalls behind them. Grey day, soft light. Safe and solemn. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
